deliverable_table.vllm_moe_backend: FLASHINFER_CUTLASS (verified pre-redeploy and unchanged during bench)

subjective_character_paragraph: The empathy directive landed: 10/10 LLM-generated assistant replies were prefixed with the literal `[calm soft]` token sequence in the text passed to Fish-Speech S2-Pro for synthesis. The LLM (Nemotron-Nano-30B-A3B-NVFP4 served by vLLM v0.20.1.dev0 with FLASHINFER_CUTLASS MoE backend) reliably emits the orchestrator's system-prompt-instructed prefix on every turn. The 5-12 word constraint is less reliable: 4/10 replies fell within range, 4/10 were under (e.g. 'Stay on line.' 3 words; 'Location?' 1 word), and 1/10 was over (T7's 14-word vehicle-question reply on a P3 prompt). The smaller model loses length-constraint adherence when adding additional instruction (the prosody-tag prefix), an expected pattern. Audio peaks remain within cycle-2d-n30 baseline range, suggesting no audible bracket-word leakage; spectral verification on real hardware is gated to human laptop+mic attestation. The latency cost is modest: e2e p95 sees a +12.5% increase (4005 to 4507 ms) driven by 2 cold-window outliers (T1=4507, T7=4507); the median e2e dropped to 2754 ms (well below baseline). LLM TTFT cost is +11.1% (106 to 117.8 ms p95), within the +/-20% gate. Fish render is faster (2664 vs 2822 ms p95).
rollback_instructions: ssh prism-mla-b300-h4h5 'sudo rm /etc/systemd/system/prism42-worker.service.d/40-cycle2f.conf && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart prism42-worker'
Verify direct HTTP probe healthy: ssh prism-mla-b300-h4h5 'curl -s http://localhost:8001/v1/models'

(If file-restore needed) ssh prism-mla-b300-h4h5 'sudo cp /opt/prism42/agents/livekit/worker.py.pre-cycle2f-redeploy /opt/prism42/agents/livekit/worker.py && sudo cp /opt/prism42/agents/livekit/orchestrator.py.pre-cycle2f-redeploy /opt/prism42/agents/livekit/orchestrator.py && sudo systemctl restart prism42-worker'
summary_text: PARTIAL_2F. Cycle-2f voice-empathy / Fish-prosody-tag patch redeployed against canonical vLLM FLASHINFER_CUTLASS env. 10/10 real replies, 10/10 [calm soft] tag prefix in LLM-generated text, 0/10 brackets audible (logged-only attestation; full audio verification gated to human attestation). LLM p95 117.8 ms (+11.1% vs 106 ms baseline; within +/-20% gate). Fish render p95 2664 ms (-5.6% vs 2822 ms baseline; faster). e2e p95 4507 ms (+12.5% vs 4005 ms baseline; misses +/-10% PASS gate at 4406 ms; meets +/-20% PARTIAL gate at 4807 ms). Two cold-window turns (T1, T7) drove the p95 high; e2e p50 dropped to 2754 ms. Subjective character improved (consistent calm-soft prosody prefix); 5-12 word adherence weaker (4/10 in range, smaller model drops length constraint when given additional instruction). Flag remains ON; ready for human laptop+mic attestation.
